transformations.operation: Removed unused properties and compacted JSON; retained every country feature and every coordinate without simplification, rounding or geometry changes. Exported iso2 prefers the original source ISO_A2_EH when it is a two-letter uppercase code, otherwise retains the source ISO_A2.
transformations.country_identifier_rule: Prefer authoritative Natural Earth ISO_A2_EH matching ^[A-Z]{2}$; otherwise retain ISO_A2. No invented country-code mappings.

transformations.operation: Matched seed city+ISO2 to NAME/NAMEASCII/NAME_EN/NAMEALT using Unicode accent/case normalization, requiring exactly one matching feature; copied GeoJSON coordinates unchanged. Supplemental DMS conversion used only for two documented Wikidata communes.

supplemental_sources.source_reference_note: Wikidata P625 cites répertoire géographique des communes; this atlas checked the Wikidata entry, not the original register.
Wikidata P625 says imported from Russian Wikipedia. This is a coarse commune representative point, not a surveyed centre or office.

representation_notes: City points represent settlements or municipalities, never architecture office locations.
Natural Earth 110m outlines are generalized small-scale map data, not survey geometry.
Boundaries reflect the selected Natural Earth source snapshot and are not a statement of political position.
Montreuil and Providencia use their own commune points; Paris and Santiago were not substituted.
Natural Earth repository VERSION identifies this snapshot as 5.2.0-pre; the exact source commit and content hashes are recorded.

coverage_notes.reason: Natural Earth 110m is generalized small-scale geometry; very small states may have no polygon. City points remain independently sourced.

ZA|Edenvale.label: Edenvale
ZA|Edenvale.evidence: Wikidata P625 for Edenvale, Gauteng, in the City of Ekurhuleni. Representative town point, not the Greenstone Hill office.

US|Petaluma.label: Petaluma
US|Petaluma.evidence: Wikidata P625 for Petaluma, Sonoma County, California. Representative city point, not the Cader Lane creamery.

BR|Joanópolis.label: Joanópolis
BR|Joanópolis.evidence: Wikidata P625 for the municipality of Joanópolis, São Paulo, Brazil. Representative municipality point, not the rural cheesery. The displayed coordinate statement has no cited reference.

ZA|Klapmuts.label: Klapmuts
ZA|Klapmuts.evidence: Wikidata P625 for Klapmuts in Stellenbosch Local Municipality, Western Cape. Representative locality point, not Dalewood farm.

CA|St-Albert.provider: Natural Resources Canada / Canadian Geographical Names Database
CA|St-Albert.evidence: Official geographical name FEBWN: St-Albert, dispersed rural community, Russell, Ontario. Government JSON supplies the point. This is not St. Albert, Alberta, and not an exact factory location.

NZ|Ōamaru.evidence: Explicit orthographic alias: maker source spells Oamaru; seed display name Ōamaru adds the macron. Natural Earth has exactly one NZ record named Oamaru. No metro substitution.

location_policy: Keep facility references distinct from municipality points; unknown coordinates stay unknown.

court_discovery.bounds: 1, 2 or 5 km radius; 500 candidate features max; explicit user requests only
court_discovery.coverage: A query returns mapped features. Some physical courts are absent, tagged incompletely or represented by larger facilities. Only independently verified operator evidence can strengthen public-access status.
court_discovery.bulk_plan: Regional OSM extracts or a dedicated provider, stored separately with ODbL lineage; no planet-wide query against a shared public API.

private_data: No personal accounts, credentials, residential locations or private contact information included.
